approved: Owner approved all four concepts for modelling in chat, 2026-11-26
source: Original concept-faithful geometry, reusing project Mesh, armature and sampled floor-registration/export helpers. No private model or external animation.
free_source_audit: Existing project free/original helpers reused. A candidate CC0 crayfish scan on Sketchfab returned 403 and was not downloaded or used; no third-party creature rights inferred from a search result.

runtime_contract.floor: Fixed metric scene floor, +Z front. Every sampled pose is fitted to floor; fall stays inside 2m footprint. Submerge flattens under a caller-owned pool surface instead of moving the actor through the floor.
runtime_contract.states: grab completes into hold loop; release returns idle; submerge and fall hold their last frame; emerge returns idle. Caller still owns combat visibility/targeting.
runtime_contract.opacity: Normal solid shader has no ALPHA. Cached preloaded fade sibling only below full opacity; exact solid shader restored at 1.0.
runtime_contract.framing: Union of all registered clip bounds, retaining both ends of presentation cross-fades.
runtime_contract.rules: No stats, enemy assignment, named-pack patrol, loot, damage, hidden attacks or map glow added.
